solver_A.name: FEBio
solver_A.binary_status: WIPED between sessions — must be rebuilt before any L3 attempt
solver_A.material_tangent_availability: FEBio can compute material tangent via its standard solid-material interface (used by Newton solver). BFGS quasi-Newton does NOT compute the true tangent; for the tangent_equivalence check, FEBio's material tangent must be extracted via a separate procedure (e.g., evaluate at two nearby deformation states and finite-difference).

solver_B.name: SfePy
solver_B.material_tangent_availability: SfePy computes the consistent tangent automatically during Newton iterations. Can also be extracted via term_mode='tan_mod' for some terms.

1_strain_energy_density.notes: Deviatoric parts identical. Volumetric parts differ: FEBio logarithmic vs SfePy quadratic penalty. Different mathematical models.

2_stress_law.notes: Same deviatoric stress. Different volumetric stress due to different SED.

3_tangent_equivalence.solver_A_tangent_at_5_states: NOT YET COMPUTED — FEBio binary wiped; must be rebuilt and material tangent extracted
3_tangent_equivalence.solver_B_tangent_at_5_states: NOT YET COMPUTED — must extract from SfePy via term_mode='tan_mod' or numerical finite-difference
3_tangent_equivalence.notes: CANNOT be verified as true until both solvers' material tangents are extracted. Currently REFUSED pending solver execution. Note: this check is downstream of check #1 — if SEDs differ, tangents will differ. Resolving check #1 (via Option A: implement (K/2)(ln J)^2 in SfePy, OR Option C: re-freeze B004 with (ln J)^2 volumetric) will likely also resolve check #3.

4_compressibility_formulation.solver_A: Mixed u-p formulation (FEBio's neo-Hookean uses log-J volumetric energy with implicit pressure)
4_compressibility_formulation.solver_B: Pure displacement formulation with quadratic penalty (dw_tl_bulk_penalty)
4_compressibility_formulation.notes: Different formulations. Even if both used (K/2)(ln J)^2, the penalty vs mixed approaches are mathematically distinct. Equivalence would need to be PROVEN, not assumed (CE-022).

5_parameter_mapping.solver_A: E=1.0, nu=0.3 -> mu=0.3846, K=0.8333 (computed internally by FEBio)

6_stress_measure.notes: Different stress measures. Must push SfePy's 2nd PK forward to Cauchy via sigma = (1/J) F S F^T before comparison. This is a remediable issue (post-processing transformation), but currently REFUSED.

audit_summary.remediation_path_preferred: Option A: implement (K/2)(ln J)^2 volumetric in SfePy via custom term, exactly replicating FEBio's SED. Then re-audit. This preserves L3-BENCHMARK-002 frozen as-is and tests true cross-solver equivalence.
